text_block_list.text:
It's time for Seiun Sky's dance lesson...
but we've
come to an arcade.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Yep, just like I said. The dance game
here looks
perfect for practicing.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Surer than sure! No doubt in my mind
we're gonna
be feeling the rhythm!
choice_data_list: I wonder if it's really effective?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: All right, let's get grooving. ♪

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Like this... now do this!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
This is harder than I thought. I might be
using
more energy than I do during
regular lessons.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Oh, here comes my score! I wonder how
good I
did.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Huh?!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I didn't make it onto the leaderboard...
Hmph. Ah
well, this was just for fun
anyways.

Seiun Sky plays for a little while longer,
but...
choice_data_list: It's technically a lesson, you know.
It's technically a lesson, you know.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff... I did better this time. Now I've... gotta be... on the leaderboard.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Come on, come ooon...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...Wait, I'm still not up there? This "TEIO" person in first place is just too good!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I gotta memorize the song and focus on
the parts
I mess up... No, wait—is that
the most efficient
way to improve?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Naaah, of course not! Why would I try
hard for
something like this?
choice_data_list: Push just a little harder and you ...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Well, time to call it a day. I'm about to
zonk out.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
It's not like me to dance till I'm
drenched in sweat!

Following this, I start hearing some
firsthand
accounts of people spotting
Seiun Sky at the
arcade...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Nah, I'm not trying too hard. That's not
really my
kind of thing.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Still... you know how it is. I feel like I
wasn't half
bad at the game.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Maybe if I practiced dancing too, I could
get that
top score someday.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Well, if you're up for it, I don't
mind
keeping you company, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
But we gotta get dancing on the double,
before
anyone notices us.

Very much out of character for her,
Seiun Sky
practices dancing until closing
time.
